title: First-class Claude Code CLI agent alongside Codex
spec: The server treats Codex as the only known coding CLI: command detection, restricted health-probe allowances, and default agent seeding are Codex-specific. Add first-class support for the Claude Code CLI in the server's agent services: detect a Claude CLI command (analogous to the existing Codex detection), allow its restricted probe invocation (claude --version style), and export the detection helper for reuse. Keep Codex behavior unchanged.
